items.claim: Islam Makhachev is the best grappler in MMA today.
items.quote: He's probably the best grappler in MMA today.

items.claim: Ian Garry has superior hand speed and movement compared to Islam Makhachev's previous opponents.
items.quote: none of them are Ian Garry. They don't have the size, they don't have the length, they don't have the movement, they don't have the striking from the outside.

items.claim: Jack Della Maddalena looked broken and scared to throw against Islam Makhachev.
items.quote: He looked really bad against Carlos Prates, and looked broken against Islam Makhachev, and was scared to throw.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson has a ridiculous top game and is one of the more violent fighters in the world from top position.
items.quote: Her top game is ridiculous. She lands a lot of good strikes from a dominant position that opens up submission opportunities.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern will bury Gillian Robertson on the feet due to superior striking.
items.quote: Mackenzie Dern buries her on the feet.
